description: This file defines the BaseHOP class, a foundational class for higher-order operations (HOP) in PyTorch, including methods for handling subgraphs, autograd, functionalization, and schema generation. It also includes a custom autograd Function class for backward computation and a utility class for functions with no free variables.

classes.name: BaseHOP
classes.description: An abstract base class for higher-order operations (HOP) in PyTorch, providing mechanisms for subgraph handling, autograd, functionalization, and schema generation.

classes.name: BaseHOPFunction
classes.description: A custom autograd Function class implementing forward and backward passes for HOP operations.

classes.name: FunctionWithNoFreeVars
classes.description: A utility class wrapping a function that has no free variables, ensuring safe invocation.

methods.name: BaseHOP.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the BaseHOP with a given hop name and registers various implementation methods.

methods.name: BaseHOP.__call__
methods.description: Invokes the hop with a subgraph and operands, ensuring the subgraph is of an acceptable type.

methods.name: _call_Autograd
methods.description: Handles autograd logic for the subgraph, applying the autograd function.

methods.name: _call_CompositeExplicitAutograd
methods.description: Handles explicit autograd mode, asserting that no dispatch mode is active.

methods.name: _call_ProxyTorchDispatchMode
methods.description: Handles proxy mode dispatch, tracing the subgraph and registering it with the tracer.

methods.name: _call_FakeTensorMode
methods.description: Handles FakeTensorMode, executing the subgraph within the mode context.

methods.name: _call_Functionalize
methods.description: Performs auto-functionalization of the subgraph if applicable, supporting input mutation.

methods.name: gen_schema
methods.description: Generates a schema for the hop, considering aliasing and mutation constraints.
